name: video-archive-backend
description: Wraps the FastAPI backend startup so it can be launched from the root npm script.

scripts.dev: python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-exclude video_archive.db --reload-exclude video_archive.db-wal --reload-exclude video_archive.db-shm --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
